configs.from: What the item IS. 'grille, type not stated' when the text gives a grille but not its type; 'none of these' for a priceable thing outside the sheet's families (owner ruling 6b: no SKU in the catalogue means the row is left blank for the user to decide). A discrete grille is 'grille, type not stated'. A row that gives only a size, or a size and a place ('600x600 for hub room'), buys the item its heading or that heading's note describes: answer that family, never 'none of these' with the size as its name. A row that buys something returns at least one item: an item outside the list is 'none of these' with 'Item as written' -- never an empty list. A damper is its own item only where the row buys the damper itself and names no host. A MOTORISED VCD'S CONTROL PANEL, ACTUATOR AND CABLING named in its heading are not separate items (owner 2026-10-23): return the VCD alone; code says on the panel that they are not included.

Open cell is Acoustic Nitrile Insulation; closed cell on a duct, sheet, wall, ceiling or slab is Thermal Nitrile Insulation, also where the row or its heading calls it acoustic insulation ('acoustic insulation ... with closed cell nitrile rubber' on a duct is Thermal Nitrile Insulation); closed cell on a pipe is Nitrile Rubber Insulation. Fibre glass, glass wool or resin-bonded glass wool of ANY density -- 32 kg/m3 included -- is ' Fiberglass Rigid Board Insulation, Density 48Kg/m3' (the density is ignored). 'none of these' for an insulation material the catalogue does not stock (rockwool, mineral wool, XLPE, phenolic, EPDM, PIR, polyethylene / EPS). A row that names only a GENERIC insulation -- 'insulation', 'insulation foam', 'foam insulation' -- and no material of its own takes the material its heading names: under a heading naming nitrile rubber it is nitrile (Nitrile Rubber Insulation on a pipe, Thermal Nitrile Insulation on a duct or sheet). Answer 'none of these' only for a material the BoQ NAMES that the catalogue does not stock; when the row and its headings name no insulation material at all, leave this out -- the pricer applies the ruled default. Where the BoQ offers materials as alternatives ('nitrile rubber/XLPE', 'rockwool/glasswool'), copy the material as written in full, both names, into 'Insulation material as written'. A row that describes only a cladding or coating applied over insulation, with no insulation material being supplied, is 'Cladding Only'. Tubular nitrile rubber, nitrile tube or nitrile tubing (any spelling of nitrile) is Nitrile Rubber Insulation; 'Tubular Puf Insulation' only where PUF or polyurethane is named.
